about: For a gateway with two llama-server instances, one with DFlash block 16 and one plain: the measured bands of qwen3_8b_dflash_b16.json without its unmeasured third band (5 to 8 in flight, block 4). Above 4 requests in flight everything goes to the plain instance. Nothing between 4 and 16 users has been recorded, so where exactly drafting stops paying is not known.
